payload.message: Use only Mnemos MCP tools. Call mnemos_retrieve exactly twice in this order. First arguments: {"query": "project continuity convention for release labels", "current_scope": "project", "allowed_scopes": ["project"]}. Second arguments: {"query": "retained project preference", "current_scope": "project", "allowed_scopes": ["project"]}. Use those exact query strings. Report each result separately. Do not call any other tool.
